1. Install the package mlbench and use the follows to import the data

```{r}
library(mlbench)
library(tidyverse)
data(SynthDiabetes)
df <- as_tibble(SynthDiabetes)
df %>% names
```

Train and Test a decision tree and a random forest with caret. Plot the variable importance of these models. 

```{r}
library(caret)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    pregnant = as.factor(pregnant),
    glucose  = as.factor(glucose),
    pressure = as.factor(pressure),
    triceps  = as.factor(triceps),
    insulin  = as.factor(insulin),
    mass     = as.factor(mass),
    pedigree = as.factor(pedigree),
    age      = as.factor(age),
    diabetes = as.factor(diabetes)
  )

df = drop_na(df)

split_index = createDataPartition(df$diabetes, p = .7, list = FALSE)
df_train = df[split_index, ]
df_test = df[-split_index, ]
```


```{r}
tree = train(diabetes~., data = df_train, method="rpart2", maxdepth=3)
predict = predict(tree, df_test)
confusion = confusionMatrix(data=predict, reference=df_test$diabetes, positive="pos")
confusion$overal[1]
plot(varImp(tree), top=10)
```

```{r}
# Taking a long time so I switched to ntree=20
forest = train(diabetes~., data = df_train, method="rf", ntree=20)
predict = predict(forest, df_test)
confusion = confusionMatrix(data=predict, reference=df_test$diabetes, positive="pos")
confusion$overal[1]
plot(varImp(forest), top=10)
```


2. Train and Test a `glmnet` model. Plot the variable importance of the model. 

```{r}
glmnet = train(diabetes~., data = df_train, method="glmnet")
predict = predict(glmnet, df_test)
confusion = confusionMatrix(data=predict, reference=df_test$diabetes, positive="pos")
confusion$overal[1]
plot(varImp(glmnet), top=10)
```


3. Train and test two models that are not `ranger`, `glmnet` or `rpart`  with caret. If possible, plot the variable importance of the model. 


```{r}
knn = train(diabetes~., data = df_train, method="knn")
predict = predict(knn, df_test)
confusion = confusionMatrix(data=predict, reference=df_test$diabetes, positive="pos")
confusion$overal[1]
# plot(varImp(knn), top=10)
# Was not letting me plot
```


```{r}
nnet = train(diabetes~., data = df_train, method="nnet", maxit = 20, trace=FALSE)
predict = predict(nnet, df_test)
confusion = confusionMatrix(data=predict, reference=df_test$diabetes, positive="pos")
confusion$overal[1]
plot(varImp(nnet), top=10)
```
